V2_PHASE.DC_treatment: Absolute phase, no per-run rotation; increments continuous acrossSPEC

FULL.DC_treatment: One complex mean per run; DC²+AC²=total²
FULL.ADC_normalization: Already physical ADC V/V²; no second factor
FULL.limitations: Temperature columns join verified INPT medians; use TEMP dependency for that measurement.

RAW.ADC_normalization: Already physical ADC V; counts/fractions invariant

configuration.continuity: FIR, oscillator and increment pairs continuous across SPEC
configuration.dc_removal: one complex mean per entire selected run, before mixing and FIR; no per-SPEC subtraction

ELECTRONIC.DC_treatment: Whole-run input complex DC removed; continuous FIR anddecimation acrossSPEC
ELECTRONIC.ADC_normalization: Already physical ADC V²; savedV²×0.16 once

TEMP.role: primary cached experimental INPT joined tov2 bounds
TEMP.ADC_normalization: Recorded mK or K; no ADC voltage scaling
TEMP.limitations: Physicalidentity fromoperator;mapping throughODB/INPTindices;4Kplate is only aHEMTstageproxy.
